text: You can't choose what happens today, only what you do with it.
Much of today's heaviness is tomorrow's imagination arriving early.
The obstacle is not in the road; it is the road, if you keep moving.
Some things answer to you. The rest only asks to be carried.
Your mind takes the color of what you keep returning to. Choose the return.
We are not short on time; we are careless with the hours we already have.
What unsettles you is not the event itself but the story you attach to it.
